 });

   const top=ground-f.h-38,left=f.x-f.w/2;
   ctx.fillStyle=f.tipo==='bar'?'#41303c':f.tipo==='comercio'?'#3d4857':'#3a475a';
   ctx.fillRect(left,top,f.w,f.h);ctx.fillStyle='#bd9864';ctx.fillRect(left-5,top-7,f.w+10,8);
   for(let r=0;r<3;r++)for(let c=0;c<4;c++){
     const wx=left+18+c*(f.w-24)/4,wy=top+19+r*30;
     ctx.fillStyle=(r+c)%3===0?'#ffbb65':'#80acc6';ctx.fillRect(wx,wy,19,16);
     ctx.fillStyle='#273041';ctx.fillRect(wx+8,wy,3,16);
   }
   ctx.fillStyle='#121d2b';ctx.fillRect(left+9,ground-75,f.w-18,30);
   ctx.strokeStyle='#e99845';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.strokeRect(left+9,ground-75,f.w-18,30);
   text(f.n,f.x,ground-54,14,'#ffcf87','center');
   if(f.tipo==='bar'){
     ctx.fillStyle='#799564';ctx.fillRect(left+28,ground-43,f.w-56,13);
     ctx.fillStyle='#f1a23d';text('BILLAR',f.x,ground-33,10,'#f9bf6e','center');
   }
 }
 // Fachadas y faroles pixel art: variedad visual sin tocar plataformas.
 for(let i=0;i<15;i++){
  const bx=90+i*205, h=65+(i*29)%65;
  ctx.fillStyle=i%2?'#3c4a59':'#46536a';ctx.fillRect(bx,ground-h-26,78,h);
  ctx.fillStyle='#c5b086';ctx.fillRect(bx+5,ground-h-29,68,6);
  for(let r=0;r<3;r++)for(let c=0;c<2;c++){
   ctx.fillStyle=(r+c+i)%3===0?'#ffcb77':'#8fb8cf';
   ctx.fillRect(bx+13+c*32,ground-h-8+r*21,13,11);
  }
 }
 ctx.restore();
}

const brandLogoImage=new Image();
brandLogoImage.src=document.getElementById('officialLogo').src;
function drawOfficialBrandBillboards(){
  const boards=level===1?[{x:1310,y:ground-187},{x:2900,y:ground-188}]:level===2?[{x:600,y:ground-185},{x:2320,y:ground-185}]:level===3?[{x:1170,y:ground-188},{x:2790,y:ground-188}]:[{x:970,y:ground-189},{x:2560,y:ground-189}];
  for(const b of boards){
    ctx.fillStyle='#1b2533';ctx.fillRect(b.x-9,b.y-8,172,104);
    ctx.strokeStyle='#e99538';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.strokeRect(b.x-9,b.y-8,172,104);
    if(brandLogoImage.complete&&brandLogoImage.naturalWidth){
      // Contenido íntegro, sin cortar ni modificar letras/proporciones.
      const iw=brandLogoImage.naturalWidth,ih=brandLogoImage.naturalHeight;
      const scale=Math.min(150/iw,79/ih);
      const dw=iw*scale,dh=ih*scale;
      ctx.drawImage(brandLogoImage,b.x+77-dw/2,b.y+43-dh/2,dw,dh);
    }
    ctx.fillStyle='#f1ad54';ctx.fillRect(b.x+12,b.y+96,5,ground-(b.y+96));
    ctx.fillRect(b.x+139,b.y+96,5,ground-(b.y+96));
  }
}

function sound(freq=440,duration=.1,type='square',vol=.025){if(!audioOn)return;try{audioCtx ||= new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();if(audioCtx.state==='suspended')audioCtx.resume();const o=audioCtx.createOscillator(),g=audioCtx.createGain();o.type=type;o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,audioCtx.currentTime);g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,audioCtx.currentTime);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,audioCtx.currentTime+duration);o.connect(g);g.connect(audioCtx.destination);o.start();o.stop(audioCtx.currentTime+duration)}catch(e){}}
